tools.name: solana_token_safety
tools.description: Use this when an agent or user is about to buy or swap into a Solana token and needs a rug / honeypot check first (for EVM tokens use evm_token_safety). Pre-buy safety check for any Solana token (SPL or Token-2022) with a 0-100 risk score, flags and plain-English verdict. Live on-chain + public data: mint and freeze authority, supply/decimals, Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, non-transferable, default-frozen, pausable), top-10 holder concentration (pools excluded), DEX liquidity/pools and LP lock (DexScreener, RugCheck), a real Jupiter sell-route quote (basic honeypot test), token age and RugCheck risks.

tools.name: sol_token_meta
tools.description: Solana SPL / Token-2022 mint metadata: decimals, total supply, mint & freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, and name/symbol/uri from on-chain metadata (Token-2022 or Metaplex), with Jupiter token list fallback. Read-only.

include_market.description: Add Jupiter token-list data (verified flag, tags, holder count, usd price); default false

tools.name: sol_token_risk
tools.description: Heuristic risk screen for a Solana token mint: mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions (permanent delegate, transfer hook/fee, default-frozen, pausable...), metadata mutability, holder concentration, DEX liquidity and pair age (DexScreener), Jupiter verification. Returns a 0-100 score with itemised flags. Read-only; not a security guarantee.

include_holders.description: Fetch top holders (getTokenLargestAccounts) for concentration analysis; default true

tools.name: token_price
tools.description: Use this when you need the current USD price of one or more crypto tokens. Live USD price, 24h % change, confidence and source timestamp for up to 10 tokens per call: tickers (BTC, ETH, SOL, PEPE), CoinGecko ids (bitcoin) or chain:address on eth, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc and solana (base:0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913). Batch, cached ~60 s, one fast call. Unknown ids come back as found:false instead of failing the batch.

ids.description: up to 10 comma-separated tickers, CoinGecko ids (or coingecko:<id>) or chain:address (eth|base|arbitrum|optimism|polygon|bsc|solana). Aliases: id, symbols, tokens

tools.name: sol_account
tools.description: Inspect any Solana account: exists or not, SOL balance (lamports), owner program with a readable name, executable flag, data size, rent-exempt minimum and status, and a classification (wallet, token account, mint, program, program data, stake, vote, lookup table, other) with the parsed fields (token amount/mint/owner, mint supply/decimals/authorities, stake delegation...). Public Solana RPC, read-only.

tools.name: sol_balance
tools.description: SOL and SPL token balances (classic SPL Token + Token-2022) for a Solana wallet address, via public Solana RPC. Read-only.

include_zero.description: Include token accounts with a zero balance; default false

include_token2022.description: Also query Token-2022 program accounts; default true

limit.description: Max token rows returned (largest UI balance first); default 100

tools.name: sol_pda
tools.description: Derive Solana program-derived addresses offline: findProgramAddress (canonical bump search) for any program and typed seeds (utf8, base58 pubkey, hex, u8/u16/u32/u64 little- or big-endian), or the associated token account (ATA) of an owner + mint for SPL Token or Token-2022. Same algorithm as @solana/web3.js (sha256 + ed25519 off-curve check). Useful to locate token accounts, Anchor PDAs and vaults without an RPC.

preset.description: ata = associated token account of owner + mint; custom = programId + seeds

seeds.description: custom: seeds as "utf8:vault", "pubkey:<base58>", "hex:0a0b", "u8:1", "u64:42", "u32be:7" (no prefix: a 32-byte base58 string is a pubkey, else utf8); JSON array if a seed contains commas

bump.description: custom: use this bump (createProgramAddress) instead of searching

owner.description: ata: wallet that owns the token account

tools.name: sol_signatures
tools.description: Recent transaction signatures that touched a Solana address (wallet, token account, mint or program), newest first, via getSignaturesForAddress: signature, slot, block time and age, success or error, memo and confirmation status, plus a summary (failed count, time span, rough tx/hour). Paginate with before=. Public Solana RPC, read-only.

before.description: Start searching backwards from this signature (pagination)

tools.name: wallet_portfolio
tools.description: Use this when you need to know what a wallet holds and what it is worth. One address in, portfolio out: for a 0x address, native coin plus ~70 curated major tokens (stablecoins, WETH/WBTC/cbBTC, LSTs, top DeFi and meme tokens) across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon and BNB Chain in parallel; for a Solana address, SOL plus every SPL / Token-2022 balance. USD value per holding, per-chain totals and a grand total (DefiLlama prices), sorted by value. Spam-free on EVM; a failing chain is reported in sources, never fails the call.

address.description: EVM address (0x...) or Solana wallet address (base58)

chains.description: EVM only: comma-separated subset of eth,base,arbitrum,optimism,polygon,bsc (default all 6)

min_usd.description: hide holdings worth less than this (default 0.01)

tools.name: wallet_risk_basic
tools.description: Basic heuristic risk screen for a Solana or EVM (Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum) wallet: activity & age, bundled OFAC-SDN / mixer list matches for the address and recent counterparties, and (EVM) live token-approval exposure (unlimited allowances, approvals to EOAs or flagged spenders). Read-only; heuristic only, not a compliance determination or security guarantee.

address.description: Solana base58 address or 0x EVM address (family auto-detected)

deep.description: More history: Solana pages up to 5000 signatures and inspects 15 recent txs; EVM finds first outgoing tx block (~25 extra RPC calls); default false

lookback_blocks.description: EVM log-scan window (capped per chain by what the keyless RPC allows)
